copper mountain.note: Welp... we need a little more winter before we can open for skiing and riding. We are extremely eager to kick off the season and plan to open as soon as possible. Mother Nature hasn't exactly been cooperating this fall. Temperatures have been cool, but not consistently cold enough for efficient snowmaking, and we've had more rain than snow. Teams are literally working around the clock, and we will take advantage of every opportunity to get you out here on a high quality and safe snow surface, as soon as possible. Be ready-we will share a new opening day as soon as we can! The whole winter is still ahead of us.
